name: Lemon Cordial
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: 1 and a half quarts French brandy
ingredients.originalText: 1 and a half quarts French brandy

instructions.text: Cut six fresh lemons in thin slices
Put them into a quart and a half of milk
Boil it until the whey is very clear
Put to this whey, one and a half quarts of French brandy, and three pounds of powdered loaf sugar
Stir it till the sugar is dissolved
Let it stand to refine, and bottle it
Pare some of the yellow rind of the lemons very thin, and put a little in each bottle

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut six fresh lemons in thin slices
2. Put them into a quart and a half of milk
3. Boil it until the whey is very clear
4. Pass it through a sieve
5. Put to this whey, one and a half quarts of French brandy, and three pounds of powdered loaf sugar
6. Stir it till the sugar is dissolved
7. Let it stand to refine, and bottle it
8. Pare some of the yellow rind of the lemons very thin, and put a little in each bottle
